description: This file defines unresolved and resolved plan nodes related to catalog objects and analysis in Spark SQL, including classes for unresolved objects (tables, views, functions, namespaces), their resolved counterparts, and catalog objects like temporary views and functions.

classes.name: UnresolvedNamespace
classes.description: Represents a namespace that has yet to be looked up in a catalog, to be resolved during analysis.

classes.name: CurrentNamespace
classes.description: Singleton object representing the current namespace of the current catalog.

classes.name: UnresolvedTable
classes.description: Represents a table name that is unresolved and will be resolved during analysis.

classes.name: UnresolvedView
classes.description: Represents a view name that is unresolved and will be resolved during analysis.

classes.name: UnresolvedTableOrView
classes.description: Represents a table or view name unresolved in the catalog, to be resolved during analysis.

classes.name: PartitionSpec
classes.description: Trait for partition specifications, not directly instantiable.

classes.name: UnresolvedPartitionSpec
classes.description: Unresolved partition specification, to be resolved during analysis.

classes.name: FieldName
classes.description: Trait for field names, unresolved state.

classes.name: UnresolvedFieldName
classes.description: Unresolved field name, to be resolved during analysis.

classes.name: FieldPosition
classes.description: Trait for field position, unresolved.

classes.name: UnresolvedFieldPosition
classes.description: Unresolved field position, to be resolved during analysis.

classes.name: UnresolvedFunctionName
classes.description: Unresolved function name, to be resolved during analysis.

classes.name: UnresolvedIdentifier
classes.description: Unresolved identifier for catalog objects.

classes.name: UnresolvedProcedure
classes.description: Unresolved procedure identifier.

classes.name: LeafNodeWithoutStats
classes.description: Trait for leaf plan nodes with dummy statistics.

classes.name: ResolvedNamespace
classes.description: Resolved namespace plan node.

classes.name: ResolvedTable
classes.description: Resolved table plan node with catalog, identifier, and output attributes.

classes.name: ResolvedPartitionSpec
classes.description: Resolved partition specification.

classes.name: ResolvedFieldName
classes.description: Resolved field name with path and StructField.

classes.name: ResolvedFieldPosition
classes.description: Resolved field position.

classes.name: ResolvedProcedure
classes.description: Resolved procedure plan node.

classes.name: ResolvedPersistentView
classes.description: Resolved persistent view plan node.

classes.name: ResolvedTempView
classes.description: Resolved temporary view plan node.

classes.name: ResolvedPersistentFunc
classes.description: Resolved persistent function plan node.

classes.name: ResolvedNonPersistentFunc
classes.description: Resolved non-persistent (temp or built-in) function plan node.

classes.name: ResolvedIdentifier
classes.description: Resolved identifier with catalog and output attributes.

classes.name: FakeSystemCatalog
classes.description: Fake catalog object for holding temp views.

classes.name: FakeLocalCatalog
classes.description: Fake catalog object for holding local variables for SQL scripting.

methods.name: ResolvedTable.create
methods.description: Creates a ResolvedTable with schema conversion.

methods.name: ResolvedIdentifier.unapply
methods.description: Extractor method for pattern matching on ResolvedIdentifier.
